description.value: Fairfield Community Place is the neighbourhood house of the Fairfield Gonzales Community Association, a non-profit serving the Fairfield and Gonzales neighbourhoods of Victoria since 1975. The single-storey building hosts a wide range of community programs including licensed childcare, youth drop-ins, community gardens, and neighbourhood events. It sits in a quiet residential area of Victoria near the waterfront.
